answer: Require each identity to escrow a 400-unit bond and serve a twenty-four epoch probation. Each round it finishes one random task and needs four endorsements from reviewers with disjoint recent partners; reused proofs, copied sentences, or same-window submissions freeze the bond for nine rounds. The ledger checks signatures, task uniqueness, reviewer independence, and timestamps. A sybil farm thus locks 400 units per alias and replays twenty-four rounds, while a trellis of linked traces exposes the ring, copper receipts prove provenance, and ledge rotation keeps tasks distinct.
